sn45.150:1.1: “All the plants and seeds that achieve growth, increase, and maturity do so depending on the earth and grounded on the earth.
sn45.150:1.2: In the same way, a meditator develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path depending on and grounded on ethics, achieving growth, increase, and maturity in good qualities.
sn45.150:1.3: And how does a meditator develop the noble eightfold path depending on and grounded on ethics, achieving growth, increase, and maturity in good qualities?
sn45.150:1.4: It’s when a meditator develops right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right composure, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
sn45.150:1.5: That’s how a meditator develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path depending on and grounded on ethics, achieving growth, increase, and maturity in good qualities.”
